title: Ticwatch 2 (Ticwear OS)
body: I have a Ticwatch 2 running Ticwear OS, not Android Wear OS.  Is there any way to get the Xdrip watchfaces pushed to my Ticwatch 2 and communicate to my phone to get data (or even directly to my MioMio)?  I set up developer mode and the 1024 thing to sync apps but don't see the watch face anywhere.

comments.body: Update:  I have the watch faces installed, however, the ticwatch can't be used as a collector or pull information from Xdrip on my phone.
How did you get the watch faves to appear

Those are relating to the Wear OS Ticwatch models. The Ticwatch 2 runs the Mobvoi OS.  I actually really like it, but Wear OS apps that need to connect to partner apps on the phone don't work.  Standalone apps do work.  I'm using my Huawei Watch, but my battery life is terrible now and it drains by 3pm.

@ronrosenbaum Would you please close this issue if you have found an answer?
If not, you can use the support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
